_comment: Scope for the breadth history reader programme. Enforced by tools/git_scope.py.
A branch matching any prefix in 'branches' may only stage paths under 'allow'.
An UNMATCHED branch is not a violation - this tool only enforces scopes that were
written down, because a check that refuses everybody gets bypassed within a day.
Written after a breadth commit used `git add -A` and swept in two joystick docs,
silently normalising another programme's deliberate raw control bytes.
